axes.pe: Penetration: market reach, delivery scale, financial health, growth, customer confidence, partnerships
axes.ma: Maturity: work delivery, technical advancement, value realisation, team maturity, support infrastructure

leaders.label: Leaders
leaders.meaning: Broad market reach plus deep, current technical capability and a long multi-sector track record.

seasoned.label: Seasoned Vendors
seasoned.meaning: Strong technical capability and consulting experience; market reach still trails the Leaders.

growth.label: Growth Vendors
growth.meaning: Notable revenue expansion; delivery maturity still catching up with the Leaders.

challengers.label: Challengers
challengers.meaning: Smaller size and scope; a narrower focus that AIM frames as enabling strong training and delivery capability.

meta.note: Scores are AIM Research's normalised indices. Quadrant boundary inferred at 0.5 on each axis from the published scores and chart. Vendor-claimed metrics are unaudited. Named platforms are recorded as facts; all descriptions are our own words.
